text.name: Maintenance & Repairs
text.tagline: Plan servicing and repairs based on equipment condition
text.description: The Cyber ERP Maintenance & Repairs module records equipment profiles, maintenance operations, failure symptoms and causes, and repair history. Defining preventive activities based on time or equipment parameters, logging emergency repair requests, and scheduling work orders around available labor and parts help organize maintenance activities. Integration with warehouse and production, along with reporting on indicators such as MTBF and MTTR, makes it possible to review downtime and maintenance performance.
benefits: Issue work orders for preventive activities
Record equipment failure history and parts usage
Analyze downtime and maintenance performance indicators

text.name: Preventive Maintenance
text.cardText: Define periodic activities and issue work orders based on time or equipment parameters.
text.description: The Preventive Maintenance system defines servicing, inspection, and maintenance operations along with the materials, tools, and skills they require. Issuing work orders based on time intervals or equipment parameters, and planning labor and parts, keeps activities organized. Recording completed work and reporting overdue activities make it possible to track the maintenance plan.
benefits: Prepare the required parts and labor
Record the service history of each asset

text.name: Emergency Repairs
text.cardText: Log unplanned repair requests and track work orders, parts used, and downtime.
text.tagline: Respond to failures and record repair history
text.description: The Emergency Repairs system records failure requests with their symptoms and causes and links them to repair work orders. Team scheduling, parts supply, and recording of work performed make the failure response process traceable. Reports on downtime and failure causes help review maintenance performance.
benefits: Track failures from request to repair
Assign teams and parts to work orders

text.name: Equipment Specifications
text.cardText: Define equipment, technical specifications, parameters, and related maintenance operations for each machine.
text.tagline: Shared profiles and structure for machinery and equipment
text.description: The Equipment Specifications system maintains the group and level structure of machinery and the profile of each machine. Recording the manufacturer, installation location, criticality, and technical parameters, and linking them to maintenance operations, creates a shared reference for planning servicing and repairs.
benefits: Record controllable parameters for each machine
